The figure beats the previously reported global record of about 97 lakh applications, set by Waaree Energies. It also tops earlier Indian record-setters such as Bajaj Housing Finance. 12:42:00 PM IST, 23 Oct 2026 Global markets | Japan's Nikkei falls, JGBs surge as AI jitters spur haven demand

The benchmark Nikkei 225 fell 0.34% to close at 62,693.16, trimming an earlier decline of more than 2%. The broader Topix slipped 0.79% to 3,965.81. 12:40:25 PM IST, 23 Oct 2026 Commodities market update | Silver futures decline to Rs 1.95 lakh/kg
 Silver prices on Friday fell by Rs 4,191 to Rs 1,95,408 per kilogram in futures trade as participants reduced their bets. 
 On the Multi Commodity Exchange, silver contracts for December delivery declined by Rs 4,191, or 2.1%, to Rs 1,95,408 per kg in a business turnover of 5,856 lots. 
 Analysts said a sell-off by participants mainly weighed on silver prices. 
 Globally, the white metal was trading 1.01% down at USD 54.01 per ounce in New York.

With this order, Welspun's global order book hit approx USD 5.25 billion (Rs 50,000 crore), an all-time high, an exchange filing said.  12:23:00 PM IST, 23 Oct 2026 Commodities market update | Gold futures decline to Rs 1.42 lakh/10 gram
 Gold prices on Friday declined Rs 1,230 to Rs 1,42,079 per 10 grams in futures trade amid a fall in spot demand. 
 On the Multi Commodity Exchange, the yellow metal contracts for December delivery traded lower by Rs 1,230, or 0.86%, at Rs 1,42,079 per 10 grams in a business turnover of 1,670 lots. 
 Analysts attributed the decline in precious metal prices to weaker spot demand. 
 Globally, gold futures declined by 0.26% to USD 4,014.23 per ounce in New York.

 09:00:00 AM IST, 23 Oct 2026 Sensex Today | Nifty 50 | Stock Market Live Updates: Blinkit, Instamart chart different paths to profitable growth
 The September 2026 results of Eternal and Swiggy highlighted a continuing trend: food delivery is gaining momentum, while quick commerce remains a key growth driver. However, the two companies are following markedly different strategies.
Eternal is aggressively expanding Blinkit, aiming to combine rapid growth with improving profitability. Blinkit added 308 net new stores during the quarter, taking its network to 2,751. It plans to increase the count to more than 3,500 stores by March 2027 and around 5,000 by March 2028. Eternal believes quick-commerce adoption is spreading beyond metros, with Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities showing encouraging customer behaviour and store-level economics. 08:50:00 AM IST, 23 Oct 2026 Sensex Today | Nifty 50 | Stock Market Live Updates: UBS Group AG acquires 4.8% stake in 360 ONE WAM after exercising warrants
 UBS Group AG has acquired a 4.8% stake in wealth manager 360 ONE WAM by exercising warrants issued by the Indian firm, more than a year after transferring its domestic wealth management business to the company.
The Swiss bank exercised more than 20.5 million warrants allotted by Mumbai-based 360 ONE, the company said on Thursday. UBS had paid 25% of the exercise price at the time of allotment and has now paid the remaining 75% to convert the warrants into shares. 08:40:00 AM IST, 23 Oct 2026 Sensex Today | Nifty 50 | Stock Market Live Updates: Nippon AMC gets Sebi nod for settlement in Yes Bank AT1 case
 Nippon Life India Asset Management said on Thursday that Sebi had granted in-principle approval for a settlement in a case involving investments by certain mutual fund schemes in YES Bank’s AT1 bonds.
The asset management company said it had paid ₹96.8 crore towards the settlement. This includes ₹89.1 crore to reverse management fees earned on the investments, along with interest, and ₹7.7 crore towards settlement amounts for the company and certain officials. The final settlement order from Sebi is awaited. 08:35:00 AM IST, 23 Oct 2026 Sensex Today | Nifty 50 | Stock Market Live Updates: Yes Bank AT1 coupon due, bondholders seek clarity
 A coupon payment on YES Bank’s additional tier-1 (AT1) bonds fell due just three days after the Supreme Court reinstated ₹8,415 crore worth of these principal instruments. However, bondholders said they had not received the payment and urged Axis Trustee Services to seek immediate clarification from the private lender.
“We call upon the Trustee to obtain immediate written confirmation from YES Bank as to whether this coupon has been paid, cancelled or remains outstanding,” a bondholders’ association said in a letter seen by ET. 08:30:00 AM IST, 23 Oct 2026 Sensex Today | Nifty 50 | Stock Market Live Updates: Banking liquidity surplus shrinks to Rs 541 crore as cash crunch increases
 The banking system’s liquidity surplus fell to just ₹541 crore as of October 21, as banks set aside additional funds to meet the daily cash reserve requirement of 99%. Consequently, the weighted average call rate (WACR) rose to 5.65% on Thursday, 15 basis points above the repo rate, according to CCIL data. 08:25:00 AM IST, 23 Oct 2026 Sensex Today | Nifty 50 | Stock Market Live Updates: Sun Pharma falls short of bond fundraising target amid rising yields
 Sun Pharmaceutical Industries, India’s largest drugmaker, raised ₹7,816 crore through five- and seven-year bond tranches, falling short of its ₹10,000-crore target, people familiar with the transaction told ET. Rising market yields prompted investors to seek returns higher than the company was willing to offer. 08:20:00 AM IST, 23 Oct 2026 Sensex Today | Nifty 50 | Stock Market Live Updates: IPO-bound companies defer launches to avoid Jio mega issue
 Jio Platforms’ mega IPO appears to have prompted several companies planning to go public to follow an old market adage: never stand in front of a freight train. These firms are reportedly postponing their share sale launches to avoid a clash with Jio’s ₹30,213 crore offering, India’s largest-ever IPO. The concern is that the issue’s sheer scale could monopolise investor attention and absorb a significant share of market liquidity. 08:15:00 AM IST, 23 Oct 2026 Sensex Today | Nifty 50 | Stock Market Live Updates: Financials, FMCG lead FPI sell-off; IT stocks buck the trend in first half of October
 Foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) continued to offload shares across most sectors, including financial services, FMCG, automobiles, healthcare and telecom, in the first half of October, while IT stocks bucked the trend to attract inflows.
